title: Affine self Ext frame over the quotient structure module
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let U be an affine open, n,m natural numbers, and f:Fin(m)\to\Gamma(Y,U) a Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence] generating i.ker.ideal(U) [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Put B=i_*\mathcal O_Z and G=H^n(R\mathcal Hom_Y(B,B)) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then G restricted to the over-U site is isomorphic to the coproduct of copies of B restricted to that site, indexed by ULift of n-element subsets of Fin(m). Coproduct means categorical direct sum in module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. No pullback or conormal identification is asserted.

proof.text: Take the quotient-coefficient component eG of koszulExtCoefficient_affine_model, applied with the canonical adjunction-unit coefficient map and length m, cohomology degree n. It identifies the ordinary restriction of G with the associated quotient-valued dual Koszul homology in the supplied derived universe.
Compose eG with the proved quotient homology frame, which identifies that associated homology sheaf with the restriction of the coproduct of B on increasing n-element subsets.

The natural isomorphism overFunctorEquiv identifies ordinary open restriction with over-site restriction followed by overEquiv.functor. Conjugate the composed isomorphism by its two components and take its preimage under this fully faithful equivalence. This gives precisely the asserted over-U isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: Reuse the existing affine Ext coefficient comparison; prove the quotient homology frame directly and transport by the open-site equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem koszul_self_ext_quotient_frame
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (U : Y.affineOpens) (n : ℕ)
    (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let G := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).obj
        (H.obj (op (S.obj B), S.obj B))
    Nonempty (G.over U.1 ≅
      (∐ fun _ : ULift.{u} (Set.powersetCard (Fin m) n) ↦ B).over U.1)
